newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market turnover on the rise.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market turnover on the rise.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market saw turnover drifting higher again to 3.3 billion lei in five days this week against 2.8 billion a week ago.
Volume this week was 1.6 million shares from an average 129 stocks traded each day.
IMEP SA electric motor maker was the most active stock. It traded more than 217,000 shares this week closing at 580 lei on Friday, up from 500 on Monday.
The Romanian OTC market, the RASDAQ, which opened last October, lists 2,312 companies. It is expected to eventually trade shares of some 5,000 stocks.
